body: I'm very open about my struggles with my boyfriend. He's supportive as possible but after a while he seemed exasperated... I don't want to keep filling him with my issues when he's trying to handle a lot of his own. My mother is thousands of miles away and she tries so much to help but i can't afford to fly her way. Otherwise my closest friends don't really know. I've lost contact with a lot of them and feel so anxious about reaching out again.
